risks.title: Late refunds never reach past days
risks.body: The incremental filter only rebuilds the latest day, so a refund settled for an older day is missed.
risks.ifItMatters: Run a full refresh weekly, or widen the filter to a lookback window.

risks.title: Refund-only days vanish
risks.body: The left join starts from orders, so a day with refunds and no orders has no row.

areas.summary: A new incremental mart joins daily orders to daily settled refunds.
